Medical Advisor Gastroenterology
description:
**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a **Medical Advisor** in the **Gastroenterology** therapeutic area — a passionate and driven professional who is eager to make an impact and join our dynamic team.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to our medical strategy and work closely with key stakeholders, reporting directly to the Medical Lead.


Main responsibilities include:

* To warrant the **medical know\-how** of the Affiliate regarding the **relevant therapeutic areas of assigned products** (including AbbVie products, competitors and general knowledge of specific diseases) and to provide internal medical training when requested/necessary.
* To drive **Medical activities** to support the **Brand Strategy** and integrate it into the Brand Plan
* To represent the Italian Affiliate in the relevant therapeutic Corporate Medical Development setting.
* To prepare the **medical plan** of activities for each product of the relevant area, on an annual basis and to update it as appropriate.
* To maintain a continuous **relationship with Key thought Leaders and External Expert** as to the relevant therapeutic area.
* To **review promotional material** before the approval of the Head Scientific Service, warranting the appropriateness of its medical content and the independence of assessment.
* To **review the Summary of Product Characteristics and Insert Leaflets**, prepared by Regulatory Affairs, before final approval of the Head Scientific Service, as to products of the relevant therapeutic area.
* To support the Scientific Training Specialist(s) of the relevant Medical Affairs Unit in preparing the annual **scientific training plan for the sales force** and its delivery, including the preparation of product handbook(s).
* To provide **medical support to the Pharmacovigilance** Unit as to AEs reported in clinical trials on the relevant products.
* To be responsible for: The **design of local AbbVie Medical Department Italy (AMDI) clinical studies**; The review, approval, fulfillment of contract agreements of **Investigator Initiated Studies (IISs).**
* To identify potential sites for carrying out International and **local clinical studies** and maintain a liaison with them throughout the study conduct in cooperation with Clinical Research Department.
* Participate to the **design of AbbVie events**, warranting an appropriate medical support to the Commercial Divisions and in agreement with the International and local SOPs.
* To contribute to the design and improvement of AMDI systems and processes (e.g. AMDI SOPs and Guidelines) with the aim of ensuring best practice as well as compliance to all applicable regulations and Company procedures

  

**Qualifications**  

* Medical **degree strongly preferred**, or Italian equivalent to Laurea Magistrale in life science/chemistry related topics.
* Minimum of 3 years’ working experience in pharmaceutical/biotechnological industry, in a scientific/medical role, within cross functional teams
* Ability to transform strategies into feasible and realistic actions
* Ability in leading, motivating, and coordinating cross functional team
* Excellent knowledge of the health sector and of its development
* Effective management of the work in a matrix structure
* Knowledge of financial principles and processes
* Fluency in written and oral English


Preferred:

* **Experience in gastroenterology therapeutic area**
* Medical Specialization, PHD in medical sciences
* Proven success in pharmaceutical/biotechnological context

  

**Additional Information**  

Your total reward package at AbbVie will be made up of multiple components, including compensation, well\-being and benefits.  

In this role, you will receive base pay and annual short term incentive subject to AbbVie's global policy. You will also receive a number of benefits including life assurance, medical plan, flexible benefits, etc.


In this role, you will also be entitled to receive a company car.


Full details of our comprehensive package will be shared during the recruitment process.


The national collective bargaining agreement applicable to this position is B011 – CCNL Chemical\-Pharmaceuticals Industry.

description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.


**Office / Unit / Project Description**

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the leading organization for sustainable development within the UN system and acts as the key integrator for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP operates across headquarters, regional, and country levels, leveraging local expertise alongside global insights to deliver effective advocacy and solutions. For six decades, UNDP has worked with partners to lift millions out of poverty and expand opportunities for all.


UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 is grounded in the determination to eradicate poverty—the greatest global challenge and a prerequisite for achieving the 2030 Agenda. Through the Strategic Plan, UNDP will continue supporting countries in advancing high human development while protecting the planet. Four strategic objectives—prosperity for all, effective governance, crisis resilience, and a healthy planet—guide its direction, powered by three accelerators: digital and artificial intelligence (AI) transformation, gender equality, and sustainable finance. All efforts are underpinned by a strong commitment to human rights and to leaving no one behind.


Within UNDP, the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) brings together world\-class policy expertise, flagship global programmes, and collaborative innovation and learning networks. BPPS ensures that UNDP is not only ready for the future but actively helps shape it with governments and partners. Working closely with the Crisis Bureau (CB), BPPS supports countries in navigating complex development and crisis contexts, integrating risk considerations into programming, and strengthening results\-based management, innovation, and data\-driven approaches.


The Global Policy Network (GPN) is central to this effort, mobilizing technical expertise to advance UNDP’s strategic objectives and signature solutions. Within the GPN, BPPS is responsible for developing policy and guidance, providing technical advice to Country Offices, representing UNDP in multi\-stakeholder fora, and supporting UN inter\-agency coordination across thematic areas.


The Italy Africa Digital Flagship initiative is implemented in close collaboration with national governments, the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Italian public and private sector partners. It focuses on advancing digital public infrastructure, digital identity systems, agritech solutions, and data\-driven governance, contributing to sustainable development and inclusive economic growth.


Within this framework, the Digital Transformation Specialist will provide senior technical leadership for the digital transformation components of the Italy–Africa Digital Development Flagship Programme. The role will focus on ensuring that digital solutions, feasibility studies, technical specifications, and implementation approaches are technically sound, interoperable, scalable, secure, and aligned with national digital priorities, international standards, and relevant donor and financing requirements. The incumbent will work closely with the Project Specialist, UNDP Country Offices, national digital counterparts, technical teams, and external partners, providing technical inputs and quality assurance to support coherent programme design and implementation.


The assignment is situated within a complex and evolving multi\-stakeholder environment, characterized by tight timelines, advanced stages of project design, and the need to align diverse partner expectations and requirements. Additional challenges include the coordination of multi\-country interventions, adaptation to specific donor formats and procedures (including AICS requirements), and ensuring consistency across projects developed in different national contexts together with the project team.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

Under the strategic guidance and supervision of the UNDP Rome Centre Senior Advisor, and in close coordination with the Project Specialist, the r Digital Transformation Specialist will serve as the primary technical authority for digital architecture, digital strategy, and ICT systems design within the programme.


The role is responsible for ensuring that digital solutions developed under the Flagship are technically sound, interoperable, scalable, and aligned with international standards and the evolving digital regulatory environments of the partner countries.


The incumbent will work at the intersection of government policy, technology architecture, and development finance, providing senior\-level technical advisory services to national governments, UNDP teams, and strategic partners. The Senior Digital Transformation Specialist will perform the following functions:


1\. Preparatory and Feasibility Studies Technical Leadership


* Lead the technical design and quality assurance of executive feasibility studies under the Italy\- Africa Digital Flagship Programme in selected countries.
* Oversee the architecture design of the feasibility studies, including GIS platforms, remote sensing integration, telemetry systems, IoT sensors, and climate advisory dashboards, ensuring full technical interoperability between physical infrastructure and digital decision\-support systems.
* Define the full technical architecture of the studies, covering high\-performance computing, cloud and hybrid deployment models, data storage and sovereignty frameworks, cybersecurity and disaster recovery systems, interoperability layers, and a sequenced pipeline of AI use cases aligned with national priorities.
* Lead the definition of data governance models, interoperability standards, and responsible AI frameworks in compliance with international regulatory requirements across both studies.
* Ensure all digital system specifications are produced to a standard sufficient to support international competitive tendering, CDP financing appraisal, and seamless transition to implementation.
* Coordinate with the UNDP Rome Centre, national digital agencies, MAECI, and Italian private sector and technology partners to ensure technical coherence, institutional ownership, and alignment with the broader Digital Flagship programme architecture.

2\. Lead Digital Strategy and Architecture


* Lead the design and continuous refinement of the digital transformation strategy for the programme across all four focus countries, ensuring technical coherence, scalability, and alignment with national digital agendas.
* Define and oversee enterprise architecture frameworks for proposed digital public infrastructure, including digital identity systems, e\-government platforms, connectivity infrastructure, data governance frameworks, and interoperability layers.
* Conduct and validate technical feasibility analyses and ICT landscape reviews in close collaboration with UNDP Country Offices and national counterparts.
* Provide authoritative technical advisory to government ministries, national digital agencies, and implementing partners on system architecture, technology stack selection, cybersecurity requirements, and data protection frameworks.
* Lead technical due diligence for proposed digital solutions, ensuring alignment with international standards (ITU, ISO, NIST), open\-source and digital public goods principles, and sustainable vendor\-neutral architecture.

3\. Lead Technical Management and Quality Assurance


* Lead the technology workstream to ensure on\-time, on\-budget delivery of digital components.
* Establish and manage an integrated programme governance structure for the digital workstream, including technical steering committees, change control boards, risk registers, and issue logs.
* Develop and maintain programme\-level technical documentation including the solution design documents, technical specifications, and supporting the procurement documentations (RFPs/TORs for ICT services and vendors), test strategies, and acceptance criteria.
* Oversee technical quality assurance and acceptance testing of delivered digital systems, ensuring contracted deliverables meet defined technical and functional standards before certification of satisfactory completion.
* Provide input to project formulation documents (ProDocs), results frameworks, and monitoring and evaluation plans as they relate to digital components.

4\. Cybersecurity, Data Governance and Risk Management


* Lead the development of cybersecurity strategies and frameworks for digital systems designed under the Flagship, informed by industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST CSF, with appropriate localization for each country context.
* Advise on data protection legislation, data sovereignty considerations, privacy\-by\-design principles, and alignment with applicable international frameworks (e.g., GDPR\-equivalent standards).
* Conduct and document IT risk assessments, articulating technical risks in terms accessible to non\-technical stakeholders; develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Ensure that all digital systems procured or developed under the programme incorporate robust access control, audit trail, and incident response capabilities.

5\. Build Strategic Partnership, Stakeholder Engagement and Capacity Development


* Serve as the senior technical interlocutor with government counterparts (Ministries of ICT, National Digital Agencies, Regulators) and strategic partners including international financial institutions, bilateral donors, and private sector entities.
* Provide technical inputs to investment cases, concept notes, and bankable project documents, translating complex technical architectures into language suitable for development finance decision\-making.
* Design and deliver capacity development sessions, technical workshops, and knowledge\-sharing events for government officials and UNDP teams on digital transformation, emerging technologies, and ICT governance.
* Represent UNDP at high\-level technical conferences, inter\-agency forums, and bilateral meetings, contributing to the programme’s visibility and positioning as a centre of technical excellence.

6/ Innovation, Emerging Technologies and Facilitate Knowledge Management


* Monitor global trends in digital public infrastructure (DPI), open\-source digital public goods (DPGs), AI\-enabled public services, cloud adoption, and emerging connectivity technologies (e.g., low\-orbit satellites, 5G/6G), and advise on their applicability in the programme context.
* Support the identification and piloting of innovative digital tools that can accelerate SDG delivery in the programme’s thematic areas (agriculture, health, climate, digital identity, tax administration).
* Contribute to UNDP’s global knowledge base through documented lessons learned, technical briefs, and replicable frameworks derived from the Flagship’s implementation experience.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.


4\. Institutional Arrangement


The Digital Transformation Specialist will report directly to the Head of the Political Affairs and Strategic Initiatives. The incumbent will be embedded within the UNDP Rome Centre and will work in close coordination with relevant teams, as well as with UNDP Country Offices in participating countries.


Under the direction of the UNDP Rome Centre Senior Advisor, the Digital Transformation Specialist will conduct regular technical coordination with UNDP Country Offices including, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, Senegal, and Mozambique, with the Italian Government (MAECI/DGCS), CDP, AICS, and with national digital counterparts.


**Competencies**

**Core competencies**

**Achieve Results** LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact
  

**Think Innovatively** LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems
  

**Learn Continuously** LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences
  

**Adapt with Agility** LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands
  

**Act with Determination** LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results
  

**Engage and Partner** LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration
  

**Enable Diversity and Inclusion** LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity


**Cross\-Functional \& Technical Competencies**

**Digital \- Co\-creation:** Ability to design and facilitate a process that enables a diverse group of stakeholders to solve a common problem, develop a practice, or create knowledge together. Ability to embrace diversity, work with a diverse group of stakeholders understand their interests, perspectives and views and tap into to them as a source for creativity. Ability to facilitate processes and create conditions that are open for diverse inputs, stimulate collaboration and sharing.
  

**Digital \- Digital ecosystems:** Knowledge of how they work, understanding of the opportunities and challenges for governments and society
  

**Digital \- Digital transformation design:** Practical and strategic skills in digital transformation for governments and organisations.
  

**Digital \- Policy/regulations for digital and emerging technology:** Ability to design or advise on regulations and policy for digital and emerging technology.
  

**Digital \- Portfolio design \& management:** Ability to identify leverage points in systems and design interventions that address them. The value of the interventions is determined not in isolation, but as part of the overall portfolio and their coherence. Ability to design processes that extract learning on an ongoing basis from existing portfolios, so that learning accrues over time and new options for action are continuously generated. Build a learning ecosystem around a complex development challenge: being able to mobilise a variety of stakeholders and help them learn and work together. Understand key principles of systems and complexity theory.
  

**Business Direction \& Strategy \- System Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system
  

**Business Management \- Monitoring \& Evaluation** : Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results. Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmark, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of client, current and upcoming. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.  

  



**Required Skills and Experience**

**Education:**

* Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Electrical / Telecommunications Engineering, Public Administration, Public Policy, or International Development with a strong ICT focus, Business Administration with specialization in Digital Transformation is required. Or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas stated above, in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 7 years (with master’s degree) or 9 years (with bachelor’s degree) of progressively responsible experience in digital transformation, ICT programme management, and digital strategy.
* At least 5 years’ experience in an international development context and/or with government entities in developing countries
* Demonstrated expertise in enterprise/solution architecture design for large\-scale digital government systems required
* Proven experience leading large\-scale digital transformation programmes or complex ICT projects in an international development context, preferably within the UN system or with multilateral institutions required
* Proven experience advising national governments on digital transformation strategy, digital public infrastructure, or e\-government platforms required.
* Track record of managing complex, multi\-country, multi\-stakeholder digital programmes in an international or UN system environment required.
* Experience with cybersecurity principles, data governance frameworks, and privacy\-by\-design methodologies required.
* Experience in developing ICT procurement strategies, technical specifications (RFP/TOR), and vendor evaluation frameworks for public sector digital projects required.
* Experience in translating complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences including senior government officials, donors, and development finance partners required.
* Experience working in or with countries in West and/or East Africa on digital transformation or e\-government initiatives desirable.
* Experience in digital public goods (DPG) ecosystems, open\-source platforms (e.g., digital Identity, OpenCRVS, DHIS2\), and interoperability frameworks (e.g., GovStack, X\-Road) desirable.
* Experience with Italy’s development cooperation ecosystem (MAECI/DGCS, AICS, CDP/ICF) and bilateral finance mechanisms desirable.
* Familiarity with UNDP programme management cycles, Results\-Based Management (RBM), and UNDP’s POPP procurement procedures for ICT services desirable.
* Experience applying PMI/PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum methodologies within a UN or international development programme context desirable.

**Languages:**

----------------------------------------------------------------


### **Do Work That Matters – Your Role and Responsibilities**

* You are able to independently lead analysis workshops and manage the direct interface with the client

* Hybrid working arrangements, promoting a healthy work\-life balance
* Advanced training and development programs to stay continuously up to date
* An international mindset and innovative projects
* Initiatives focused on psychophysical wellbeing

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria.

  


### **Together for Better – Our Values and Our Commitment**



Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, community engagement, and integrity: these are the Values of KPMG, which give life to an environment open to the exchange of ideas and knowledge, enabling our professionals to reach their full potential.



Through our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace, our Network complies with the ISO 30415 standard (Diversity \& Inclusion Management System) and UNI PdR 125 (Gender Equality). Amazon's Legal Department is looking for a talented technology lawyer to support Amazon Web Services (AWS) in selling to commercial and public sector customers throughout the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region, with a primary focus on supporting AWS sales in Italy and Southern Europe. The successful candidate will be responsible for drafting, negotiating, and advising on strategic technology service agreements with enterprise customers, public sector customers, and partners, as well as providing legal support for local and regional services and initiatives. The role includes participating in other legal team projects, including managing legal issues that arise in existing relationships and handling customer and business partner inquiries. We are looking for a candidate who is proactive, entrepreneurial, enjoys being challenged, has strong technology and communication skills, and demonstrates sound, pragmatic judgment in ambiguous situations.  

  

The applicable collective agreement for this role is for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

You will work with various teams within the AWS organisation.
